about_the_game:
Costumes with swimsuit designs for a new type of adventure. Adds costumes for the 6 party members.

Content Details:
- "Bright Treasure" Swimsuit Costume for Rias
- "Ocean Hero" Swimsuit Costume for Slade
- "Street Aestus" Swimsuit Costume for Raze
- "Beachside Witch" Swimsuit Costume for Wilbell
- "Coral Fairy" Swimsuit Costume for Totori
- "Sunset Relaxation" Swimsuit Costume for Sophie

Note:
- Costumes can be equipped after the main menu is unlocked by selecting "Combat Equipment" followed by "Change Costume."
- This product is part of "The Red Alchemist & the White Guardian - Atelier Season Pass." Please be aware that there are other products which contain this content. Be careful not to make duplicate purchases.
- Please check the official site for details.
